notes.title: Sentient Noir DEMO V2 - UPGRADE!
notes.content:
[b] DEMO UPDATE V2[/b]

Hi guys, we're happy to announce that  [b] version 2[/b] of our demo has been released for you to play. This build has a lot of improvements we think you guys would love. So here's what we've got so for:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38765149/d507f68f7dda22f7baa2edb03ada0800842397b5.png[/img]

[list]
[*] New lighting and particle FX for characters and environments
[list]
[*] New idle and intro animations for prologue
[/list]
[list]
[*] polish to combo attacks for Huru
[/list]
[list]
[*] Huru now can take up to 4 hits during her base state
[/list]
[list]
[*] new soundtrack added to Winter street
[/list]
[list]
[*] Gun shop! You can purchase guns at the store if you're adventurous enough!
[/list]
[list]
[*] Huru now has gunslinger mechanics!
[/list]
[list]
[*] You can now access the alleyway and the Spot Plaza areas
[/list]
[list]
[*] More tutorials have been added
[/list]
[list]
[*] Overall optimization
[/list]
[/list]

I'm sure there's more we've left out but this list should hold some weight as to why to upgrade your demo. We genuinely hope you have a great time with the game as we think we're finally seeing the fun-factor in this project.

Again, any questions, constructive feedback would be appreciated. And if you like what we're making, then please go ahead and share your enthusiasm with your friends and families.

For the players.
